Iter57 mitigation was to `wait_for_selector('[data-testid="pagination-range"]', timeout=60000)` before reading — result was '1–32 από 32 παραστατικά' with 32 rows, no empty-state, exactly matching the shared clamp behaviour of /projects, /customers, /quotes.
